text.content:
The ambulance you get when you didn't pay Trauma Team.

Kind: Cut-rate private ambulance service
Base: REO Meatwagon (#60), Japantown
Purpose: Handling the cases Trauma Team won't, which is most of them

Half the price of Trauma Team and twice as slow. REO Meatwagon runs old ground ambulances held together with tape. Half its patients don't reach the hospital alive, some don't reach it at all, and there are rumors of links to scavs. Some of its paramedics are good; don't count on getting one of them. It goes into Pacifica, where Trauma Team won't, for triple fare.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.28; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.03, 09, 12
